mechanism: Meclizine has anticholinergic properties that may reduce GI motility and affect spironolactone absorption; additive orthostatic hypotension risk from spironolactone's potassium-sparing diuretic effects and meclizine's CNS depression.
action: Monitor for dizziness and orthostatic hypotension; advise patients to rise slowly from sitting or lying positions; ensure adequate hydration; no dosage adjustment typically required.
